1339-2034-5042-7924.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw two cards due to Teferi's Ageless Insight.
The Locust God triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4279-6026-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-2292-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-2292-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-4474-7968--206.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
728-3249-4474-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1445-2279-4871-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-1976-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

803-3413-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-5075-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-5075-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Ogre Slumlord triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

129-1409-3755-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7296-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-7296-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7296-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

338-4716-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4716-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2092-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3680-4004-7149.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Stunt Double enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Stunt Double leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Stunt Double from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3581-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2558-4659-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

252-4871-7292.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-7292.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-3459-4474-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

575-997-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-997-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 6.

2692-2893-3875-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3473-6124.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
3473-6124.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Herald of Eternal Dawn.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
3473-6124.notes: Note that if Herald of Eternal Dawn is removed from the battlefield, you will lose the game due to Transcendence's effect.

215-4010-6633-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6633-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2034-2713-3862-4013.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-2713-3862-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Orcish Bowmasters.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2060-4029-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

3934-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra and Determined Iteration trigger.
Resolve the Mishra trigger, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get four {E}.
Resolve the Determined iteration trigger, creating a token copy of the Mishra's Warform token.
When the copy of the Mishra's Warform token enters the battlefield, it, Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get six {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

67-2517-5231-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2517-5231-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding {R}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2397-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

575-2167-5318.description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl by paying {G}, causing the Forest to become a 1/1 Elemental that is still a land until end of turn.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing the Forest, adding {G}.
The Forest dies, triggering Yedora, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

1455-2450-2743.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat one additional time.
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

112-565-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
112-565-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

2503-2726-3096.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Relfections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Inverter of Truth.
The Inverter of Truth token enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
The nontoken Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1768-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four +1/+1 counters.
1768-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Juniper Order Ranger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a Saproling, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Juniper Order Ranger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling token with no counters on it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

2882-4474-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4474-4675-4694.description:
Cast Paradise Mantle by paying {0}.
Paradise Mantle enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Paradise Mantle from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
